tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Page background (the paper). Ground for ink, ink-muted, accent-text and every *-text token.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the top and bottom bars, inputs. Same ink tokens as surface.

tokens.name: color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the ruler track, skeletons, read-only settings, Stepper value box. ink and ink-muted still pass on it.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (16:1 light, 14.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, units, timestamps on any surface (≥5.8:1 light, ≥7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Strong 2px sticker borders on controls, cards and avatars; the ruler indicator. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: color-line-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, list separators, minor ruler ticks. Decorative only: never the only cue for a control's edge.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, selected chips, switch on-track, the ruler tape. Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: color-primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary controls.

tokens.name: color-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-strong (11:1).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Accent fill: impostor tag, the solution line on the reveal, celebration bursts. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (4.7:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text on any surface ('Eres el impostor', the solution value).

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px outline, 2px offset, always drawn on the surface around the control (≥5:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: color-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind BottomSheet.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success fill: 'Enviado', 'Conectado', impostor caught. Teal, pushed toward blue so it never relies on red/green hue against danger. Text on it is on-success.

tokens.name: color-on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success.

tokens.name: color-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success background tint (badges, banners). Text on it is success-text.

tokens.name: color-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on surfaces and on success-soft.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill: urgent countdown ring, 'Reconectando…'. Text on it is on-warning.

tokens.name: color-on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning.

tokens.name: color-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning background tint.

tokens.name: color-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on surfaces and on warning-soft.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill: destructive buttons, the last seconds of the countdown, errors. Text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: color-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger.

tokens.name: color-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger background tint (input error, error banners).

tokens.name: color-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger text on surfaces and on danger-soft (error messages).

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info fill. Text on it is on-info.

tokens.name: color-on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on info.

tokens.name: color-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info background tint (neutral notices, toasts).

tokens.name: color-info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on surfaces and on info-soft.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: estimate
styles.usage: The estimate value in EstimateRuler, condensed (wdth 78), tabular. Always the largest thing on the round screen.

styles.name: estimate-md
styles.usage: Estimate value with 8–10 characters (auto-chosen by EstimateRuler).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: GameCodeDisplay and CodeInput characters. Readable across a table.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero titles: verdict, podium winner, error screens. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles (Heading level 1), solution value on the reveal.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings (Heading level 2), question text in QuestionCard.

styles.name: base
styles.usage: Body copy, buttons, inputs (16px stops iOS zooming on focus).

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: Badges, ruler tick labels, overlines. Minimum size anywhere.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Base unit. Tailwind multiplies it for any numeric utility (p-3 = 12px).

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tick label offset.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact groups (badge rows, avatar stacks), minimum gap between touch targets.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows; inner padding of chips and badges.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; Card padding; default Stack gap.

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Large section gaps; EmptyState padding.

tokens.name: spacing-10
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room above display titles.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Large touch targets (Button lg, CodeInput boxes height base).

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Top padding of celebratory hero blocks (podium).

tokens.name: spacing-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in both dimensions (min-h-touch, size-touch).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, ruler tick label pills, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, CodeInput boxes, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, QuestionCard, VoteOption tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: BottomSheet top corners, podium blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, pills, SegmentedControl.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Raised controls (Button primary/secondary, VoteOption, Card interactive). Collapses to 0 when pressed: that is the pressed state.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-sm
tokens.usage: Small raised controls: chips, IconButton, Stepper buttons, avatars in the podium.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers: Toast, ConnectionBanner.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: BottomSheet and the sticky BottomActionBar when content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Dividers and the subtle line (line-subtle). Tailwind: border.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Every control and card outline in line colour (the sticker look). Tailwind: border-2.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Selected state outline (VoteOption, closest estimate), the ruler indicator. Tailwind: border-3.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed-state feedback (shadow collapse).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, toggles, chip selection, value pops.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, banners entering; scoreboard row moves.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Countdown turning urgent, ScoreDelta rise.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Reveal: markers dropping onto the ruler, the solution line drawing in (staggered 40ms per player).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for things entering or settling.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving from one place to another (scoreboard reorder).

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small celebratory overshoot: ScoreDelta, the 'Enviado' stamp. Never on layout.

tokens.name: z-bar
tokens.usage: TopBar and BottomActionBar.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: ConnectionBanner.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: BottomSheet and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region, above everything.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width of the app column (Screen). Phones fill it; tablets and laptops see a centred column.
